tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation refuted the previous generic saturating-gradient model, while the archive specifies the two-layer siphon law matching the observed saturation and open-branch gradient shifts. Fit its three parameters numerically to all paid rows and let fresh confirmation test it.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid observations already span gradient values and show the direction-changing gradient effect; the refutation points to the specific inhibited-siphon/open-branch structure, which is fit-able from these rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Saturating input with a free gradient interaction
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The prior smooth ad hoc model was refuted at RMSE 0.1605, so retain the demonstrated saturating response but use the specific gradient inhibition and square-root branch term indicated by the recalled source mechanism.
Observed responses are smooth and condition-dependent, with no high-frequency sign oscillation or evidence that stationary mechanisms are broadly refuted.
